Name: Mod NPC Sandwich Biscuit - More Romance - English
Author: EvellynYuri
Description:
[size=3]Hello! This is a fanmade translation with a lot of creative freedom of the Mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13255]Sandwich Biscuit[/url]﻿ by [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/151847838][size=3]RoseTeenager[/size]
[/url]
? [size=4]This is a Mod of a Mod, so download either the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13255]chinese version[/url] or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13340?tab=files]english version[/url] [b]FIRST[/b].[/size]
[size=3](The chinese version has the HD portraits you will need later, or you can download my own [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13610]Shiqing HD Portrait Mod[/url].)

? 1.0.2 - More bug fix. + Shi is ready!

❗ [u]There's a lot of dialogue changes, so you can consider this nearly a R18 fanfic mod.[/u] ❗
❗ [u] Shiqing doesn't dare hurt the farmer, he just wants to [b]kidnap you[/b] with a lot of care and love.[/u] ❗
❗ [u] Replace the original mod's files with my files.[/u] ❗

? Coming soon: Animations and cutscenes.
[/size]
